proves.claim: A main-test run whose cases all pass but whose file exceeds its test-file budget writes a keyed step-0 receipt naming those cases as passing and the file as over budget.

api.io-recheck.budget-only-keys-cases.why: Without it the run keys nothing and every gate waiting on that file stays unknown for good.

proves.claim: In a budget-only main run an item failing a case main passed reads as new, and only the same file budget failure reads as main-owned.

api.io-recheck.budget-only-no-mask.why: Without it a budget overrun on main could excuse an item's own failing case.

proves.claim: A main-test run that names no cases and did not finish, or lacks its budget line or passing outcome frames, still writes no receipt.

api.io-recheck.budget-only-unfinished.why: Without it a crashed run could key a receipt that no case backs.
